name: Ookami to Tea Time
source:
Rin, daughter of a feudal lord, had lived a reasonably peaceful life surrounded by her eccentric brothers. But then, everything changed when she'd received a summons from her father to the main estate.

"A werewolf has infiltrated our household. Whoever finds the evidence and uncovers the werewolf shall become the next head of the family."

At first, she thought it was a nasty joke, but early the next morning, her father was murdered by an unknown assailant.

The main family's secrets, the mutual sleuthing among relatives...and her trusted brothers' sudden change in behavior.

Caught in a whirlpool of suspicions, who can Rin possibly trust?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8625]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
凛是一位封建领主的女儿，在她古怪的兄弟们的包围下过着相当平静的生活。但当她接到父亲的召唤前往主庄园时，一切都发生了变化。

“狼人潜入了我们家，谁找到了证据，揭开了狼人的真面目，谁就将成为下一任家主。”

起初，她以为这是一个下流的玩笑，但第二天一早，她的父亲被身份不明的袭击者谋杀了。

主家的秘密、亲人之间的相互窥探……以及她最信任的兄弟们的突然转变。

陷入怀疑的漩涡中，凛还能相信谁呢？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8625]Novelgame[/url]]
